title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

Bitcoin falls below $50,000 by May 18, 2027

The year-end markets (Kalshi 0.265, Polymarket 0.22) price a 21% fall inside six weeks, which is a volatility near 58% a year. Carried to May 18 at that volatility with no drift, the chance of touching $50,000 is about 0.57; volatility this high rarely lasts six months, so I use about 0.50 for the whole window, which leaves 0.34 for the months after December given no touch before.
